nodes.description: uint256 public id, ERC1155 token id auctioned
address public token, ERC1155 contract address set in constructor
bool public ended, auction finalization flag
uint256 public startBidTime, auction start timestamp
address payable public haus, fee recipient
address payable public seller, NFT owner
uint256 public bidLength, duration before bids can be outbid/ended
uint256 public auctionLength, total auction duration
uint256 public lastBid, current highest bid amount
uint256 public lastBidTime, timestamp of last bid
address payable public winning, current highest bidder
constructor(uint256 _start, address payable _seller, address payable _haus) sets token, id, startBidTime, lastBid, seller, haus
bid() payable, refunds previous bidder via transfer before updating lastBid/winning
end() transfers ERC1155 to winner, pays haus fee and seller, sets ended
pull() returns ERC1155 to seller when no bids exist
live() external view, computes whether auction is still running from timestamps
onERC1155Received(...) external pure returning the ERC1155 receiver selector
msg.sender, caller address used as bidder/winner
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time used for all auction gates
tx.origin, used in require(msg.sender == tx.origin) to block contracts
winning.transfer(lastBid) in bid(): ether sent to attacker-controlled address before state update
haus.transfer(hausFee) in end(): external value transfer after ERC1155 callback
seller.transfer(address(this).balance) in end(): full balance transfer
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom in end(): external call to untrusted token contract before ended is set
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom in pull(): external callback to token contract
lastBid.mul(105).div(100) bid-increment arithmetic via SafeMath in bid()
balance.div(20).mul(3) haus fee arithmetic via SafeMath in end()
local uint256 balance = address(this).balance in end()
local uint256 hausFee = balance.div(20).mul(3) in end()
constructor parameter _start assigned to startBidTime
constructor parameter _seller assigned to seller
constructor parameter _haus assigned to haus

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in bid() to set winning and to compare with tx.origin
tx.origin participates in the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) access gate of bid()
block.timestamp governs start, end and outbid windows in bid()
block.timestamp decides whether end() may finalize the auction
block.timestamp decides whether pull() may return the NFT to the seller
live() status is derived purely from block.timestamp comparisons
winning address (set from msg.sender) is the recipient of the refund transfer in bid()
lastBid amount is transferred out before lastBid/winning are updated
bid() performs the refund transfer prior to state mutation, enabling re-entrant bidding
msg.sender becomes winning and therefore controls the refund recipient
bidLength bounds how long the previous bid must stand in bid()
auctionLength bounds the overall auction period in bid()
lastBidTime is read and later overwritten in bid()
startBidTime gates whether bidding has begun
bid() computes the minimum next bid with mul/div arithmetic
lastBid is the operand of the 105/100 multiplication and division
end() transfers the haus fee after the untrusted ERC1155 external call
haus is the destination of the fee transfer in end()
end() forwards the remaining balance to seller after external interaction
seller is the destination of the remaining balance transfer
end() calls into the ERC1155 token contract, giving it control before ended is set
token address defines the callee of the safeTransferFrom call in end()
winning (msg.sender derived) is passed as the recipient to safeTransferFrom
id is passed as the token id argument to safeTransferFrom in end()
pull() calls into the ERC1155 token contract before setting ended
token address defines the callee of the safeTransferFrom call in pull()
id is passed as the token id argument to safeTransferFrom in pull()
end() computes the house fee using div then mul
hausFee is derived from the local balance value
contract balance (captured in balance) is what seller receives in end()
hausFee is the amount passed to haus.transfer in end()
constructor parameter _start flows into startBidTime
constructor parameter _seller flows into seller
constructor parameter _haus flows into haus
end() sets ended to true after distributing funds
pull() sets ended to true after returning the NFT
ended is checked by require(!ended) at the start of end()
ended is checked by require(!ended) at the start of pull()
lastBidTime is required to be non-zero before end() can run
lastBid is emitted in the Won event by end()
winning is read and emitted as the auction winner in end()
startBidTime + auctionLength gates finalization in end()
haus state variable is assigned in the constructor
seller state variable is assigned in the constructor
token state variable is assigned in the constructor

normalization_plan.reason: balance only exists to compute the haus fee via div/mul, so it folds into that arithmetic operation
hausFee is produced solely to be passed into haus.transfer and has no independent identity
_start is a constructor-only argument immediately stored into startBidTime
_seller is a constructor-only argument immediately stored into seller
_haus is a constructor-only argument immediately stored into haus
